dates.bounds: Inclusive first day, exclusive following day in app.timezone

case_events.latest: meta.latest_recorded_event_id/at, full authorized retained source, not current page

scan_sessions.partial_sources: meta.total=null; meta.availableTotal is supported scoped source only
scan_sessions.sort: normalized created_at desc, immutable batch UUID desc; missing time last
scan_sessions.cursor_owner: P23 session collection only; not P08 event or P09 case cursors

scan_session_detail.extension: data.p23.batch/counts; data.events retains P08 paging and safe projection

invariants: Fresh actor/auth session/active warehouse scope checked using P08
Persisted warehouse and tenant discriminator checked before union/dedup
Canonical batch and event IDs deduplicated before filter/total/paging
No current SKU/code lookup replaces scan evidence
Batch creator is not assumed to be event actor
created_at is not started_at or ended_at
Ended scan is not posting proof
P08 OTHER includes explicit REJECTED; not complete rejection total
No fallback to legacy /scan/events; no business mutation or seed on live

pending_source_or_ba.batch_no_started_ended_status: Only existing persisted columns; missing fields are null, no new writer or backfill
pending_source_or_ba.actor_display: No historical display snapshot; null with status, no current-account fabrication
pending_source_or_ba.raw_reason_serial_sku_quantity: P08 safe event projection retained; additional source/ACL contract pending
pending_source_or_ba.rejected: counts.rejected=null until complete approved mapping; explicitRejected is literal REJECTED subset of OTHER
pending_source_or_ba.issued_quantity: null until persisted batch-to-posted-document quantity mapping is approved
pending_source_or_ba.case_document_links: Not enabled without verified persisted target mapping and detail permission checks
pending_source_or_ba.related_document_event_id: null; no joins by prefixes, timestamps or current lookup

validation.ci_data: Disposable SQLite memory / PostgreSQL p23_contract_test only; not live evidence
validation.live_smoke: GET-only existing records; independent allowed/denied sessions, wrong warehouse/direct ID/date/PII checks; do not create sessions or post stock
